Name: AutoPickaxe
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[left][b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod can help you avoid the hassle of clicking the mouse; you can mine just by moving.
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Equip your pickaxe.   
[*]Move the farmer close to the stones.
[/list][list]
[*]You can also use the [color=#6d9eeb][b]right mouse button[/b][/color] to mark ore nodes, allowing for a mining style that balances automation and manual efforts, effectively managing stamina conservation.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28666/28666-1729288559-511645318.gif[/img]﻿
If you care about game balance, the default configuration won't raise any concerns about cheating.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28666/28666-1729288633-119659198.gif[/img]﻿
If you pursue efficiency, you can modify the config to significantly increase mining efficiency.[/left]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28666/28666-1730368411-1138561301.gif[/img]
This is an example of eliminating hoe dirt.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28666/28666-1730368544-342232283.gif[/img]
If you think indiscriminate mining is too wasteful of stamina, then using the marking method for mining might be worth a try.
